subject: ArmVirtPkg: Add a helper function to initialise Arm CCA HOBs
reasons: This commit adds a new function ArmCcaInitialiseHobs() to both the real and NULL implementations of ArmCcaInitPeiLib. It is new functionality being added, not a structural transformation of existing code.

The change adds one new function to two C files (library + null stub). While the parallel real/null pattern is common in edk2, the change itself is not a repeatable match-and-replace pattern across a codebase.
Coccinelle is suited for transforming existing patterns, not for generating new function implementations.
